archival_memory.patient_medical_history_2024:
Fasting blood glucose: 135 mg/dL; A1C: 6.9%; Morning readings: 125-130 mg/dL. Action plan: Increase dietary fiber, reduce refined carbs, add light exercise after meals, and monitor daily glucose levels. Weekly routine includes post-meal walks and fiber-rich meals.

Cholesterol results: Total cholesterol: 195 mg/dL(acceptable); LDL: 130 mg/dL(elevated, target: under 100 mg/dL); HDL: 58 mg/dL(excellent); Triglycerides: 140 mg/dL(slightly elevated). Action plan: Increase intake of healthy fats(avocados, nuts, olive oil); reduce saturated fats(red meat, full-fat dairy); maintain current HDL levels; monitor triglycerides regularly.

Blood pressure: 138/85 mmHg(last check-up); target: below 130/80 mmHg. Home readings: 135–140 mmHg(systolic), 80–90 mmHg(diastolic). Factors affecting readings: stress, salt intake. Action plan: Reduce sodium intake, increase water consumption, monitor stress levels, and consider mindfulness or relaxation techniques to support blood pressure control.

Vitamin D: Level: 22 ng/mL(deficient; normal range: 30-50 ng/mL). Action plan: Start 2,000 IU daily supplement; retest in 3-6 months to monitor improvement. Note: Sunlight exposure may be limited due to Kansas weather, especially in winter.

Thyroid: TSH: 2.1 mIU/L(normal range: 0.5-4.5 mIU/L); T4: 1.2 ng/dL(normal). Status: Stable and well-controlled. Levothyroxine dosage is effective. Recommendation: Continue regular monitoring every 6–12 months, especially during seasonal changes or if symptoms shift.

Bone density: Spine T-score: -1.8 (osteopenia); Hip T-score: -1.5 (borderline). Action plan: Increase strength training(e.g., resistance exercises, bodyweight workouts); boost calcium and vitamin D intake; take calcium supplement with vitamin K2 for better absorption. Dietary changes: Add dairy and leafy greens; ensure consistent vitamin D supplementation. Follow-up: Repeat bone density scan in 1–2 years to monitor progression.
